title: Real estate services in Barcelona · HousySpace
description: Real estate services in Barcelona: sales, valuation, rentals and management, personal shopper, investment, renovations and legal, tax and financial advice.

items.text: Services
One commitment, many ways to help you.
Owners
Sell, value *or rent your home*

items.title: Property sales and brokerage
items.text: We advise you on the sale of your home, from the initial study and the sales strategy to the closing of the transaction.

items.title: Property valuation
items.text: We analyse the market and the features of your property to help you determine its value and a suitable asking price.

items.title: Rentals and property management
items.text: We market your home, select candidates and, if you need it, manage the rental throughout the contract.
Buyers and investors
Buy *or invest with judgement*

items.title: Real estate personal shopper
items.text: We search for and analyse homes according to your needs and support you through the purchase process, up to the signing.

items.title: Real estate investment
items.text: We study investment opportunities, costs, potential returns and risks to help you make decisions with judgement.
Specialist advice and solutions
Professional support *at every decision*

items.title: Renovations and interior design
items.text: We coordinate renovation and interior design projects with specialised professionals, from the first quote to the handover.

items.title: Legal and tax advice
items.text: We coordinate the advice of legal and tax professionals for the legal and tax needs of your transaction.

items.title: Financial advice
items.text: We put you in touch with financing specialists and coordinate the mortgage study with your property transaction.
Common situations
You may *be here*

items.title: Do I sell or rent?
items.text: We compare both options with numbers: sale price, expected rent, taxes and costs.

items.title: Do I sell now or wait?
items.text: We look at how demand is in your area and what changes if you wait.

items.title: I have inherited a home
items.text: What procedures there are, what taxes to pay and what to do with it.

items.title: Do I renovate before selling?
items.text: Which improvements can help the sale and which are not worth it.

items.title: I want to move home
items.text: How to coordinate the sale of yours and the purchase of the new one.

items.title: I want to invest in housing
items.text: What to buy, with what numbers and with what risks.
How we help you
Advice *that starts by listening to you*

Not every real estate decision starts with a sale. Sometimes the first thing is to understand what you need, analyse the possibilities and decide which is the best path. At HousySpace we study each situation to offer you personalised advice, with judgement and without hasty decisions.

items.title: Conversation
items.text: We talk about your situation and what you want to achieve.

items.title: Analysis
items.text: We study the property, the area and the alternatives.

items.title: Roadmap
items.text: We propose the steps, the timings and the costs.

items.title: Support
items.text: We help you decide and, if you want, to carry it out.
Not sure *which service you need?*
Let's talk!
